name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx for three virtual hosts with HTTP-to-HTTPS redirects, development TLS certificates, static content, security headers, rate limiting, Fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and kernel network hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, service enablement, logging, and compatibility adjustments to the generated Redis configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI application with Python tooling, PostgreSQL database and user provisioning, application source synchronization, virtual environment dependencies, environment configuration, and a systemd service.
